# STEP C — main loop uses part3_formulas defined above (do not edit)

```{r part3_sensitivity_loop, warning=FALSE}
part3_results <- list()

for (ctrl_age in SENSITIVITY_AGES) {
  
  label <- scenario_label(ctrl_age)
  cat("\n\n====================================================\n")
  cat("  Running Part 3 sensitivity | scenario:", label, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")
  
  pd <- process_raw_data(raw_data, ctrl_age) %>%
    left_join(accum_rates_df, by = "gap_ID") %>%
    left_join(ablat_rates_df, by = "gap_ID")
  
  # Accumulation and ablation models — formulas from part3_manual_selection (STEP B)
  m_accum1 <- lm(part3_formulas$accum1[[label]], data = pd)
  m_accum2 <- lm(part3_formulas$accum2[[label]], data = pd)
  m_accum4 <- lm(part3_formulas$accum4[[label]], data = pd)
  m_accum5 <- lm(part3_formulas$accum5[[label]], data = pd)
  m_accum6 <- lm(part3_formulas$accum6[[label]], data = pd)
  m_ablat1 <- lm(part3_formulas$ablat1[[label]], data = pd)
  m_ablat2 <- lm(part3_formulas$ablat2[[label]], data = pd)
  m_ablat3 <- lm(part3_formulas$ablat3[[label]], data = pd)
  m_ablat4 <- lm(part3_formulas$ablat4[[label]], data = pd)
  
  get_age_pval <- function(s) {
    if ("age" %in% rownames(s$coefficients)) round(s$coefficients["age", "Pr(>|t|)"], 5) else NA
  }
  get_age_coef <- function(s) {
    if ("age" %in% rownames(s$coefficients)) round(s$coefficients["age", "Estimate"], 5) else NA
  }
  get_model_pval <- function(s) {
    round(pf(s$fstatistic[1], s$fstatistic[2], s$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE), 5)
  }
  
  s1  <- summary(m_accum1); s2  <- summary(m_accum2)
  s4  <- summary(m_accum4); s5  <- summary(m_accum5); s6  <- summary(m_accum6)
  sa1 <- summary(m_ablat1); sa2 <- summary(m_ablat2)
  sa3 <- summary(m_ablat3); sa4 <- summary(m_ablat4)
  
  part3_results[[label]] <- data.frame(
    scenario = label,
    n_sites  = nrow(pd),
    
    # accum1 has no age predictor so we only store model-level stats
    accum1_model_pval = get_model_pval(s1), accum1_adjR2 = round(s1$adj.r.squared, 4),
    
    accum2_age_coef = get_age_coef(s2), accum2_age_pval = get_age_pval(s2), accum2_adjR2 = round(s2$adj.r.squared, 4), accum2_model_pval = get_model_pval(s2),
    accum4_age_coef = get_age_coef(s4), accum4_age_pval = get_age_pval(s4), accum4_adjR2 = round(s4$adj.r.squared, 4), accum4_model_pval = get_model_pval(s4),
    accum5_age_coef = get_age_coef(s5), accum5_age_pval = get_age_pval(s5), accum5_adjR2 = round(s5$adj.r.squared, 4), accum5_model_pval = get_model_pval(s5),
    accum6_age_coef = get_age_coef(s6), accum6_age_pval = get_age_pval(s6), accum6_adjR2 = round(s6$adj.r.squared, 4), accum6_model_pval = get_model_pval(s6),
    
    ablat1_age_coef = get_age_coef(sa1), ablat1_age_pval = get_age_pval(sa1), ablat1_adjR2 = round(sa1$adj.r.squared, 4), ablat1_model_pval = get_model_pval(sa1),
    ablat2_age_coef = get_age_coef(sa2), ablat2_age_pval = get_age_pval(sa2), ablat2_adjR2 = round(sa2$adj.r.squared, 4), ablat2_model_pval = get_model_pval(sa2),
    ablat3_age_coef = get_age_coef(sa3), ablat3_age_pval = get_age_pval(sa3), ablat3_adjR2 = round(sa3$adj.r.squared, 4), ablat3_model_pval = get_model_pval(sa3),
    
    # ablat4 has no age predictor so we only store model-level stats
    ablat4_model_pval = get_model_pval(sa4), ablat4_adjR2 = round(sa4$adj.r.squared, 4)
  )
}

part3_sensitivity_table <- do.call(rbind, part3_results)
rownames(part3_sensitivity_table) <- NULL

cat("\n\n===== PART 3 SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS RESULTS =====\n")
print(part3_sensitivity_table)
```

Then the predictor stability chunk for Part 3 — this re-runs `ols_step_best_subset` for every accumulation and ablation variable across all scenarios:

```{r part3_predictor_stability, warning=FALSE}

# Models that include age as a predictor (these are the ones sensitive to control site age)
accum_age_models <- c("accum2", "accum4", "accum5", "accum6")
ablat_age_models <- c("ablat1", "ablat2", "ablat3")

part3_predictor_results <- list()

for (ctrl_age in SENSITIVITY_AGES) {
  
  label <- scenario_label(ctrl_age)
  pd <- process_raw_data(raw_data, ctrl_age) %>%
    left_join(accum_rates_df, by = "gap_ID") %>%
    left_join(ablat_rates_df, by = "gap_ID")
  
  n <- nrow(pd)
  
  calc_AICc <- function(aic_vec, n) {
    sapply(seq_along(aic_vec), function(i) {
      k <- i
      aic_vec[i] + (2 * k * (k + 1)) / (n - k - 1)
    })
  }
  
  row <- data.frame(scenario = label, n_sites = n)
  
  # Loop through each response variable that has age as a predictor
  for (resp in c(accum_age_models, ablat_age_models)) {
    
    mod_full <- lm(as.formula(paste(resp,
                   "~ age + slope + size + BA + TPH + avg_shrub_ht +
                    per_shrub_cover + neighbor_ht + northness + eastness +
                    small_tree_ratio")),
                   data = pd)
    
    subsets  <- ols_step_best_subset(mod_full)$metrics
    aicc     <- calc_AICc(subsets$aic, n)
    best_idx <- which.min(aicc)
    
    row[[paste0(resp, "_best_predictors")]] <- subsets$predictors[best_idx]
    row[[paste0(resp, "_best_AICc")]]       <- round(aicc[best_idx], 3)
    row[[paste0(resp, "_n_predictors")]]    <- best_idx
  }
  
  part3_predictor_results[[label]] <- row
}

part3_predictor_table <- do.call(rbind, part3_predictor_results)
rownames(part3_predictor_table) <- NULL

# --- Print results by response variable ---
cat("\n===== PART 3 PREDICTOR STABILITY CHECK =====\n")

for (resp in c(accum_age_models, ablat_age_models)) {
  
  cat("\n---", resp, "---\n")
  cols <- c("scenario", "n_sites",
            paste0(resp, "_n_predictors"),
            paste0(resp, "_best_AICc"),
            paste0(resp, "_best_predictors"))
  print(part3_predictor_table[, cols])
  
  # Flag changes from Age 50 baseline
  pred_col <- paste0(resp, "_best_predictors")
  ref      <- part3_predictor_table[[pred_col]][1]
  changed  <- part3_predictor_table[[pred_col]] != ref
  
  if (any(changed)) {
    cat("  *** Predictors changed from Age 50 baseline in:",
        paste(part3_predictor_table$scenario[changed], collapse = ", "), "***\n")
  } else {
    cat("  Predictors stable across all scenarios\n")
  }
}
```

```{r part3_sensitivity_plots, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
p3_age  <- part3_sensitivity_table %>% filter(scenario != "No controls") %>%

# Generic plot function for Part 3
make_part3_plot <- function(coef_col, pval_col, model_label, line_color = "steelblue") {
  
  noct_coef <- p3_noct[[coef_col]]
  noct_pval <- p3_noct[[pval_col]]
  
  # Coefficient plot
  pc <- ggplot(p3_age, aes(x = age_num, y = .data[[coef_col]])) +
    geom_line(color = line_color, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, color = line_color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = noct_coef, linetype = "dotdash", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 52, y = noct_coef, label = "No controls",
             color = "darkgreen", vjust = -0.5, size = 2.8) +
    labs(title = paste(model_label, "- age coefficient"),
         x = "Control Site Age", y = "Age Coefficient") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  
  # P-value plot
  pp <- ggplot(p3_age, aes(x = age_num, y = .data[[pval_col]])) +
    geom_line(color = line_color, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, color = line_color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = noct_pval, linetype = "dotdash", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    annotate("text", x = 52, y = noct_pval, label = "No controls",
             color = "darkgreen", vjust = -0.5, size = 2.8) +
    labs(title = paste(model_label, "- age p-value"),
         x = "Control Site Age", y = "p-value (age)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  
  list(coef = pc, pval = pp)
}
```

## Summary Table: Are the conclusions robust?

This  includes the "No controls" scenario in the robustness check. A model is
flagged as **Robust** only if the age effect is consistent in direction and
significance level across ALL five scenarios (50, 60, 70, 80, and no controls).

```{r sensitivity_summary_table}

robustness_check <- function(pvals, coefs, model_name) {
  sig_consistent  <- all(pvals < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) || all(pvals >= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  sign_consistent <- all(coefs > 0, na.rm = TRUE)    || all(coefs < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  status <- if (sig_consistent && sign_consistent) "Robust" else
            if (!sign_consistent) "SENSITIVE - sign flip" else
            "SENSITIVE - significance changes"
  
  data.frame(
    Model        = model_name,
    Min_age_pval = round(min(pvals, na.rm = TRUE), 5),
    Max_age_pval = round(max(pvals, na.rm = TRUE), 5),
    Min_age_coef = round(min(coefs, na.rm = TRUE), 5),
    Max_age_coef = round(max(coefs, na.rm = TRUE), 5),
    NoCtrl_pval  = round(pvals[length(pvals)], 5),   # last entry = "No controls"
    NoCtrl_coef  = round(coefs[length(coefs)], 5),
    Robustness   = status
  )
}

robustness_table <- rbind(
  robustness_check(part1_sensitivity_table$age_pval_ln_best,
                   part1_sensitivity_table$age_coef_ln_best,  "ln(March SD) - Part 1"),
  robustness_check(part1_sensitivity_table$age_pval_SDD_best,
                   part1_sensitivity_table$age_coef_SDD_best, "SDD - Part 1"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$accum2_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$accum2_age_coef,   "accum2 - Part 3"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$accum4_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$accum4_age_coef,   "accum4 - Part 3"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$accum5_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$accum5_age_coef,   "accum5 - Part 3"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$accum6_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$accum6_age_coef,   "accum6 - Part 3"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$ablat1_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$ablat1_age_coef,   "ablat1 - Part 3"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$ablat2_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$ablat2_age_coef,   "ablat2 - Part 3"),
  robustness_check(part3_sensitivity_table$ablat3_age_pval,
                   part3_sensitivity_table$ablat3_age_coef,   "ablat3 - Part 3")
)
```

## Note on MARSS Models (Part 2)

The MARSS models were not re-run in this sensitivity analysis because each run
takes many hours, and there are 12 constrained models × 2 bin sizes × 4 age
scenarios = 96 total runs (plus bootstrapping for the best model).

s
